{{Quote|We have come from the recent battle at Half-Axe Pass&mdash;''"<br>"Half-Axe Pass?!'' If you survived ''that'', you must be the ''only ones!''|Dass Jennir and [[Meekerdin-maa]]|<ref name="DT 1" />}}
'''Half-Axe Pass''' was a [[Stone/Legends|rocky]] pass between two low [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]],<ref name="CSWE" /> located near<ref name="DT 1" /> the planet's largest [[Cadgel Meadows spaceport|spaceport]] at [[Cadgel Meadows]].<ref name="CSWE Cadgel Meadows">{{CSWECite|I|104|Cadgel Meadows}}</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The date of [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> it was the site of the intense<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Battle of Half-Axe Pass]]<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> during the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]].<ref name="DT 1" /> The battle was fought between a [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance organization]] led by the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Dass Jennir]],<ref name="Republic 80">[[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]]</ref> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. The Nosaurians were defeated and summarily executed after surrendering to the Empire, and their families fleeing to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] were captured and sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="DT 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Half-Axe Pass first appeared in the comic [[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]], written by [[Randy Stradley]] under the pen name Welles Hartley and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Republic 80" /> on [[December 21]], [[2005]].<ref name="Rep 80 release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54526/star_wars_republic_2002_80|text=Star Wars: Republic (2002) #80}}</ref> The location was unnamed until the release of [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]<ref name="DT 1" /> on [[November 8]], [[2006]],<ref name="DT 1 release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54075/star_wars_dark_times_2006_1|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #1}}</ref> which was the first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' comic series which continued from the end of ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'', and written by Stradley under the pseudonym Mick Harrison.<ref name="DT 1" />
